title: Cortex Box Health Status
description: The single normative GET /health response shape for every Cortex pillar box (BOX-STANDARD §3 / PRD WS-CTX-4 / ledger D6). Required fields: status, box, version, contracts_version, deploy_parity, siblings, checked_at. Extensions live under extra. Health is the one unauthenticated endpoint; D7 fail-closed applies to everything else. Status: DRAFT v0 — ships with contracts-v0.2.0; bump $id on breaking changes.

status.description: Aggregate box health. Sibling unreachable ⇒ degraded (never a 5xx from /health itself). error = the box itself cannot serve its primary job.

box.description: Canonical box name: cortex | mnemos | maestro | agent-fabric | surfaces | forge.

version.description: Semver (or honest build identifier) of the running box process.

contracts_version.description: The consumed @cortex/contracts / cortex-contracts release version (e.g. 0.2.0). Advertised so fleet monitors can detect contract-version skew.

running_sha.description: Git SHA the running process baked at boot (null if unknown).

release_tag.description: Release tag baked at build time when available (null for host-native / untagged).

match.description: true when running_sha is a clean checkout of current HEAD; null when unknowable.

siblings.description: ADR-0018 degrade-not-fail: named sibling boxes this process depends on, with reachability and which features degrade when unreachable.

relationship.description: Why this sibling matters to this box (e.g. dispatch, memory, routing).

degraded_features.description: Features of THIS box that degrade when the sibling is unreachable.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of this health check.

extra.description: Box-specific extensions (relay state, queue depth, etc.). Must not redefine required fields.
